hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if echo "$CMD" | grep -q "git commit"; then echo "Running ruff before commit..." >&2; cd "$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".cwd")" && ruff check src/ --fix >&2 && ruff format src/ >&2 || { echo "{\"decision\": \"block\", \"reason\": \"ruff check/format failed. Fix lint errors before committing.\"}"; exit 0; }; fi; echo "{\"decision\": \"approve\"}"'
